Hello! Here are the probation and compensation details.

All new Virtual Assistants begin with a one-week paid probation period so that both you and the company can assess whether the position is a good mutual fit.

Week 1 – Probation
Pay: $120 per week
Schedule: Up to 6 hours per day, 6 days per week

Your probation performance will be assessed using the following criteria:

Accuracy and attention to detail
Communication and responsiveness
Ability to follow instructions
Reliability and consistency
Professionalism and work ethic

After Successful Probation

Successful completion of probation will raise your weekly pay to $180 per week, with up to 6 hours per day, 6 days per week.

Performance Reviews & Pay Increases

After you have worked with us for 2 weeks to 1 month, we will conduct a performance review.

If your work consistently demonstrates accuracy, precision, strong communication, reliability, and a positive work ethic, you may receive a weekly increase of $70 or more. This would bring your pay from $180 to at least $250 per week.

Additional raises remain available as you grow with the company. Pay increases depend on factors including:

Completing tasks accurately with minimal errors
Following instructions precisely
Meeting deadlines consistently
Excellent communication
Taking initiative and solving problems independently
Dependability and professionalism
Contributing ideas that help improve the business

We aim to create a long-term team in which dedicated Virtual Assistants are rewarded for consistent, high-quality performance. As your responsibilities and contributions increase, your compensation can continue growing too.

Because I enjoy connecting travelers with excellent places, I believe your property would be a strong fit for future visitors. I would like to promote your Airbnb for free through travel content, recommendations, and exposure to potential guests.

The purpose is to increase the property’s visibility and bring it to the attention of more people considering a trip to Malaysia.
